You would have to feed a troll to downvoat a troll. No thanks.

A few instances of "downvoated for trolling" isn't that tasty a response for a troll, most trolls look for an emotional, long-winded response.

A small set of options that can be left as reasons for a downvoat would also work, like the way reddit currently has a small set of reasons to be left for reporting a submission or comment.

So instead of a user coming into a community, doing something wrong and getting mass downvoates with no reason, they're still downvoated, but not to the extent as they normally would be because fewer people are going to go to the length of clicking the downvoat button and selecting or typing out a reason, and they also get a chance to understand why they're getting downvoated.

I've seen people get huge numbers of downvotes for very shaky reasons, among them: the user's identity/reputation, the user's previous submissions/comments, their ability to spell correctly, their lack of knowledge about a subject. Subreddits have experimented with hover-text on the downvote button, but there's no way to guarantee that a user can't just downvote out of spite and close the tab.

We already have a threshold of 100 CCP before enabling downvoating. An additional click to select "spam" or "off topic content" or to enter a short message really isn't much more of a barrier. Allowing mods to customise that list would be nice.

Then the question becomes one of things like "should reasons that a comment was downvoated by a user be visible to other users?", "should they be comments?", "should they be searchable?", "should they allow replies/voating themselves?". I don't have the answer to these questions, but I know I'd like to see options for mods.

I think it would have a lot of unforeseen consequences, but regardless, it would be very interesting to see this implemented on a few subverses. Maybe it wouldn't be that hard to handle, maybe it would be a cluster. Who knows?

Downvoats are not meant to be a disagree button. If you disagree with a statement, reply with a counterargument. If someone is obviously trolling, says something that adds absolutely nothing to the conversation (or even detract from it), you downvoat them.
